title: Senior Salesforce Developer (Freelancer)
text:

You will be responsible for the full development lifecycle, from technical requirements gathering to deployment, ensuring that our Salesforce instance remains scalable, efficient, and aligned with business goals.

• System Integration: Design and implement REST/SOAP APIs to connect Salesforce with third-party systems and middleware.

• Salesforce Clouds: Deep experience with Sales Cloud and Service Cloud (Experience Cloud or Financial Services Cloud is a plus).

• Integrations: Proven track record of handling API integrations and managing authentication (OAuth).

•Tools: Experience with Salesforce CLI, VS Code, and Version Control (Git/GitHub/Bitbucket).

• DevOps: Familiarity with deployment tools like Copado, Gearset, or Azure DevOps.


Soft Skills & Qualifications:


• Problem Solving: Ability to translate abstract business requirements into concrete technical solutions.

• Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills for collaborating with stakeholders and cross-functional teams


Certifications:


• Required: Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I.

• Preferred: Platform Developer II, App Builder, or Administrator.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.


What We Offer:


• Opportunity to lead technical workstreams on high-impact projects.

• Access to the latest Salesforce features and continuous learning opportunities.

• Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package. fixed-price

Se buscan comerciales para Latinoamérica; el idioma materno debe ser el portugués o el español. Necesito apoyo para abrir mercado en Argentina, Brasil y Uruguay. El trabajo consiste en llamar a potenciales distribuidores o mayoristas, identificar al responsable de compras, conseguir sus datos directos y presentarles nuestro catálogo. Quiero conversaciones de calidad que siembren las bases de una relación comercial estable; no tengo prisa, prefiero resultados sólidos.

Trabajo con un pequeño CRM online y hojas de cálculo compartidas, así que registrarás cada contacto y el resultado de la llamada allí mismo. Si dominas herramientas parecidas (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce o simplemente Google Sheets) mejor aún; lo importante es que todo quede documentado con claridad.

Entrego:
• Guía de presentación, lista inicial y acceso al CRM.

Espero recibir de tu parte:
• Lista de distribuidores/ mayoristas contactados con datos verificados.
• Notas breves de cada llamada (fecha, persona, interés detectado).
• Próximos pasos sugeridos para afianzar la colaboración.

Idioma materno español o portugués indispensable para lograr una comunicación fluida con los decisores en la región.

Start handling day-to-day tickets on your shift. First 90 days: Independently resolve most user issues during your shift. Deliver your first admin project from requirements through deployment. First 6 months: Own a portfolio of admin projects, cut recurring tickets through permanent fixes, and become a trusted partner to sales leadership and the developer.
